messages:
maria: Quick thought — our cross-pool page flips spike tail latency. Proposal: a vmem ownership gateway that serializes contested transfers and issues advisory tokens.

alex: Is this runtime API or a separate coordinator?

maria: Runtime exposes `acquire_ownership(page_id)`/`release_ownership(page_id, token|hint)`. Gateway batches and arbitrates only on detected contests.

jasper: Different from evictor leases?

maria: Evictor lease is optimistic & tenant-local. Gateway handles cross-pool collisions and provides `steal_hint` so old owner can deflate.

sudha: Single-coordinator risk — availability + extra latency.

maria: Mitigations: optimistic fast-path; arbitrate only on conflict; gateway batch with bounded wait; fast-claim fallback if gateway unreachable after X ms.

kevin: Need HMAC-signed tokens for auditability. Recovery: epoch reclamation and fast-claim counters.

alex: Telemetry: contested_acq/s, arbitration_p90, fast_claim_rate, flip_hot_pages.

jasper: Config knobs: contest_window_ms, gateway_batch_size, fast_claim_threshold_ms, hotness_threshold. Default conservative + opt-in tenants.

maria: Rollout: telemetry-only mock -> opt-in canary -> tighten thresholds. I'll prototype mock. Action items: maria prototype, jasper+sudha instrument callsites, kevin draft token scheme, alex add metrics.

ci-bot: Created tasks INF-1423..INF-1426.

maria: Will write a short RFC with mock perf next week. Call out issues now or I'll proceed. :thumbsup:
